audit_status.source_base: Greek Revelation text tradition with Isaiah/Ezekiel/new Jerusalem imagery; draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for new heaven/earth, New Jerusalem, no more death, Alpha/Omega, city measurements, no temple, nations' glory.

verses.restored: And I saw new heaven and new earth, for first heaven and first earth went away, and sea is no more.

familiar.text: And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea.

modern.text: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth, for the first heaven and earth had passed away, and the sea was no more.

original.text: Καὶ εἶδον οὐρανὸν καινὸν καὶ γῆν καινήν· ὁ γὰρ πρῶτος οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ πρώτη γῆ ἀπῆλθαν, καὶ ἡ θάλασσα οὐκ ἔστιν ἔτι.

verses.restored: And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from the Divine, prepared as bride adorned for her husband.

familiar.text: And I John saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down from God out of heaven, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

modern.text: I saw the holy city, the new Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

original.text: καὶ τὴν πόλιν τὴν ἁγίαν Ἰερουσαλὴμ καινὴν εἶδον καταβαίνουσαν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ, ἡτοιμασμένην ὡς νύμφην κεκοσμημένην τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς.

verses.restored: And I heard great voice from throne saying: Look, dwelling of Divine is with humans, and he will dwell with them; they will be his peoples, and Divine himself will be with them.

familiar.text: And I heard a great voice out of heaven saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, and be their God.

modern.text: And I heard a loud voice from the throne saying: “Behold, the dwelling place of God is with man, and He will dwell with them. They will be His people, and God Himself will be with them as their God.

original.text: καὶ ἤκουσα φωνῆς μεγάλης ἐκ τοῦ ⸀θρόνου λεγούσης· Ἰδοὺ ἡ σκηνὴ τοῦ θεοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀνθρώπων, καὶ σκηνώσει μετʼ αὐτῶν, καὶ αὐτοὶ ⸀λαοὶ αὐτοῦ ἔσονται, καὶ αὐτὸς ὁ θεὸς ⸂μετʼ αὐτῶν ἔσται⸃,

verses.restored: And he will wipe every tear from their eyes, and death will be no more; neither grief nor crying nor pain will be anymore, because first things went away.

familiar.text: And God shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.

modern.text: ‘He will wipe away every tear from their eyes,’ and there will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain, for the former things have passed away.”

original.text: καὶ ἐξαλείψει πᾶν δάκρυον ⸀ἐκ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν αὐτῶν, καὶ ὁ θάνατος οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι· οὔτε πένθος οὔτε κραυγὴ οὔτε πόνος οὐκ ἔσται ⸀ἔτι. τὰ πρῶτα ἀπῆλθαν.

verses.restored: The One sitting upon throne said: Look, I make all things new. And he says: Write, because these words are trustworthy and true.

familiar.text: And he that sat upon the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he said unto me, Write: for these words are true and faithful.

modern.text: And the One seated on the throne said, “Behold, I make all things new.” Then He said, “Write this down, for these words are faithful and true.”

original.text: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ καθήμενος ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ· Ἰδοὺ ⸂καινὰ ποιῶ πάντα⸃. καὶ ⸀λέγει· Γράψον, ὅτι οὗτοι οἱ λόγοι ⸂πιστοὶ καὶ ἀληθινοί⸃ εἰσιν.

verses.restored: And he said to me: They have happened. I am the Alpha and Omega, beginning and completion. To the thirsty I will give from spring of water of life freely.

familiar.text: And he said unto me, It is done. I am Alpha and Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give unto him that is athirst of the fountain of the water of life freely.

modern.text: And He told me, “It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. To the thirsty I will give freely from the spring of the water of life.

original.text: καὶ εἶπέν μοι· ⸂Γέγοναν. ἐγὼ⸃ τὸ Ἄλφα καὶ τὸ Ὦ, ἡ ἀρχὴ καὶ τὸ τέλος. ἐγὼ τῷ διψῶντι δώσω ἐκ τῆς πηγῆς τοῦ ὕδατος τῆς ζωῆς δωρεάν.

verses.restored: The one conquering will inherit these things, and I will be Divine to that one, and that one will be child to me.

familiar.text: He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.

modern.text: The one who overcomes will inherit all things, and I will be his God, and he will be My son.

original.text: ὁ νικῶν κληρονομήσει ταῦτα, καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτῷ θεὸς καὶ αὐτὸς ἔσται μοι υἱός.

verses.restored: But for cowardly, untrusting, abominable, murderers, sexually misusing, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in lake burning with fire and sulfur, which is second death.

familiar.text: But the fearful, and unbelieving, and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.

modern.text: But to the cowardly and unbelieving and abominable and murderers and sexually immoral and sorcerers and idolaters and all liars, their place will be in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur. This is the second death.” The New Jerusalem

original.text: τοῖς δὲ δειλοῖς καὶ ⸀ἀπίστοις καὶ ἐβδελυγμένοις καὶ φονεῦσι καὶ πόρνοις καὶ φαρμάκοις καὶ εἰδωλολάτραις καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ψευδέσιν τὸ μέρος αὐτῶν ἐν τῇ λίμνῃ τῇ καιομένῃ πυρὶ καὶ θείῳ, ὅ ἐστιν ὁ θάνατος ὁ δεύτερος.

verses.restored: One of seven messengers with seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying: Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.

familiar.text: And there came unto me one of the seven angels which had the seven vials full of the seven last plagues, and talked with me, saying, Come hither, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb’s wife.

modern.text: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls full of the seven final plagues came and said to me, “Come, I will show you the bride, the wife of the Lamb.”

original.text: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἷς ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλων τῶν ἐχόντων τὰς ἑπτὰ φιάλας, ⸂τῶν γεμόντων⸃ τῶν ἑπτὰ πληγῶν τῶν ἐσχάτων, καὶ ἐλάλησεν μετʼ ἐμοῦ λέγων· Δεῦρο, δείξω σοι τὴν ⸂νύμφην τὴν γυναῖκα⸃ τοῦ ἀρνίου.

verses.restored: And he carried me away in Spirit upon great high mountain and showed me holy city Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from Divine,

familiar.text: And he carried me away in the spirit to a great and high mountain, and shewed me that great city, the holy Jerusalem, descending out of heaven from God,

modern.text: And he carried me away in the Spirit to a mountain great and high, and showed me the holy city of Jerusalem coming down out of heaven from God,

original.text: καὶ ἀπήνεγκέν με ἐν πνεύματι ἐπὶ ὄρος μέγα καὶ ὑψηλόν, καὶ ἔδειξέν μοι τὴν ⸀πόλιν τὴν ἁγίαν Ἰερουσαλὴμ καταβαίνουσαν ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ θεοῦ,

verses.restored: having glory of Divine, its radiance like very precious stone, like jasper, clear as crystal.

familiar.text: Having the glory of God: and her light was like unto a stone most precious, even like a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

modern.text: shining with the glory of God. Its radiance was like a most precious jewel, like a jasper, as clear as crystal.

original.text: ἔχουσαν τὴν δόξαν τοῦ θεοῦ· ὁ φωστὴρ αὐτῆς ὅμοιος λίθῳ τιμιωτάτῳ, ὡς λίθῳ ἰάσπιδι κρυσταλλίζοντι·

verses.restored: It had great high wall, twelve gates, and at gates twelve messengers, and names written, which are names of twelve tribes of sons of Israel.

familiar.text: And had a wall great and high, and had twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names written thereon, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel:

modern.text: The city had a great and high wall with twelve gates inscribed with the names of the twelve tribes of Israel, and twelve angels at the gates.

original.text: ἔχουσα τεῖχος μέγα καὶ ὑψηλόν, ἔχουσα πυλῶνας δώδεκα, καὶ ἐπὶ ⸂τοῖς πυλῶσιν⸃ ἀγγέλους δώδεκα, καὶ ὀνόματα ἐπιγεγραμμένα ἅ ⸀ἐστιν τῶν δώδεκα ⸀φυλῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραήλ·

verses.restored: From east three gates, north three, south three, west three.

familiar.text: On the east three gates; on the north three gates; on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

modern.text: There were three gates on the east, three on the north, three on the south, and three on the west.

original.text: ἀπὸ ⸀ἀνατολῆς πυλῶνες τρεῖς, καὶ ἀπὸ βορρᾶ πυλῶνες τρεῖς, καὶ ἀπὸ νότου πυλῶνες τρεῖς, καὶ ἀπὸ δυσμῶν πυλῶνες τρεῖς·

verses.restored: The wall of city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of twelve apostles of Lamb.

familiar.text: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and in them the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

modern.text: The wall of the city had twelve foundations bearing the names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

original.text: καὶ τὸ τεῖχος τῆς πόλεως ⸀ἔχων θεμελίους δώδεκα, καὶ ἐπʼ αὐτῶν δώδεκα ὀνόματα τῶν δώδεκα ἀποστόλων τοῦ ἀρνίου.

verses.restored: The one speaking with me had golden measuring reed, so he might measure city and gates and wall.

familiar.text: And he that talked with me had a golden reed to measure the city, and the gates thereof, and the wall thereof.

modern.text: The angel who spoke with me had a golden measuring rod to measure the city and its gates and walls.

original.text: Καὶ ὁ λαλῶν μετʼ ἐμοῦ εἶχεν μέτρον κάλαμον χρυσοῦν, ἵνα μετρήσῃ τὴν πόλιν καὶ τοὺς πυλῶνας αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ τεῖχος αὐτῆς.

verses.restored: The city lies four-square; its length as great as width. He measured city with reed: twelve thousand stadia; length, width, height are equal.

familiar.text: And the city lieth foursquare, and the length is as large as the breadth: and he measured the city with the reed, twelve thousand furlongs. The length and the breadth and the height of it are equal.

modern.text: The city lies foursquare, with its width the same as its length. And he measured the city with the rod, and all its dimensions were equal—12,000 stadia in length and width and height.

original.text: καὶ ἡ πόλις τετράγωνος κεῖται, καὶ τὸ μῆκος αὐτῆς ⸀ὅσον τὸ πλάτος. καὶ ἐμέτρησεν τὴν πόλιν τῷ καλάμῳ ἐπὶ ⸀σταδίους δώδεκα ⸀χιλιάδων· τὸ μῆκος καὶ τὸ πλάτος καὶ τὸ ὕψος αὐτῆς ἴσα ἐστίν.

verses.restored: He measured its wall: one hundred forty-four cubits, measure of human, which is of messenger.

familiar.text: And he measured the wall thereof, an hundred and forty and four cubits, according to the measure of a man, that is, of the angel.

modern.text: And he measured its wall to be 144 cubits, by the human measure the angel was using.

original.text: καὶ ἐμέτρησεν τὸ τεῖχος αὐτῆς ἑκατὸν τεσσεράκοντα τεσσάρων πηχῶν, μέτρον ἀνθρώπου, ὅ ἐστιν ἀγγέλου.

verses.restored: Its wall-building was jasper, and city pure gold like clear glass.

familiar.text: And the building of the wall of it was of jasper: and the city was pure gold, like unto clear glass.

modern.text: The wall was made of jasper, and the city itself of pure gold, as pure as glass.

original.text: ⸀καὶ ἡ ἐνδώμησις τοῦ τείχους αὐτῆς ἴασπις, καὶ ἡ πόλις χρυσίον καθαρὸν ὅμοιον ὑάλῳ καθαρῷ·

verses.restored: Foundations of city wall were adorned with every precious stone: jasper, sapphire, chalcedony, emerald,

familiar.text: And the foundations of the wall of the city were garnished with all manner of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, a chalcedony; the fourth, an emerald;

modern.text: The foundations of the city walls were adorned with every kind of precious stone: The first foundation was jasper, the second sapphire, the third chalcedony, the fourth emerald,

original.text: ⸀οἱ θεμέλιοι τοῦ τείχους τῆς πόλεως παντὶ λίθῳ τιμίῳ κεκοσμημένοι· ὁ θεμέλιος ὁ πρῶτος ἴασπις, ὁ δεύτερος σάπφιρος, ὁ τρίτος χαλκηδών, ὁ τέταρτος σμάραγδος,

verses.restored: sardonyx, carnelian, chrysolite, beryl, topaz, chrysoprase, jacinth, amethyst.

familiar.text: The fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolyte; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, a topaz; the tenth, a chrysoprasus; the eleventh, a jacinth; the twelfth, an amethyst.

modern.text: the fifth sardonyx, the sixth carnelian, the seventh chrysolite, the eighth beryl, the ninth topaz, the tenth chrysoprase, the eleventh jacinth, and the twelfth amethyst.

original.text: ὁ πέμπτος σαρδόνυξ, ὁ ἕκτος σάρδιον, ὁ ἕβδομος χρυσόλιθος, ὁ ὄγδοος βήρυλλος, ὁ ἔνατος τοπάζιον, ὁ δέκατος χρυσόπρασος, ὁ ἑνδέκατος ὑάκινθος, ὁ δωδέκατος ἀμέθυστος·

verses.restored: The twelve gates were twelve pearls; each gate from one pearl, and street of city pure gold like transparent glass.

familiar.text: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls: every several gate was of one pearl: and the street of the city was pure gold, as it were transparent glass.

modern.text: And the twelve gates were twelve pearls, with each gate consisting of a single pearl. The main street of the city was pure gold, as clear as glass.

original.text: καὶ οἱ δώδεκα πυλῶνες δώδεκα μαργαρῖται, ἀνὰ εἷς ἕκαστος τῶν πυλώνων ἦν ἐξ ἑνὸς μαργαρίτου· καὶ ἡ πλατεῖα τῆς πόλεως χρυσίον καθαρὸν ὡς ὕαλος διαυγής.

verses.restored: And I saw no temple in it, for Lord Divine Almighty is its temple, and the Lamb.

familiar.text: And I saw no temple therein: for the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are the temple of it.

modern.text: But I saw no temple in the city, because the Lord God Almighty and the Lamb are its temple.

original.text: Καὶ ναὸν οὐκ εἶδον ἐν αὐτῇ, ὁ γὰρ κύριος, ὁ θεός, ὁ παντοκράτωρ, ναὸς αὐτῆς ἐστιν, καὶ τὸ ἀρνίον.

verses.restored: The city has no need of sun nor moon to shine on it, for glory of Divine illumined it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

familiar.text: And the city had no need of the sun, neither of the moon, to shine in it: for the glory of God did lighten it, and the Lamb is the light thereof.

modern.text: And the city has no need of sun or moon to shine on it, because the glory of God illuminates the city, and the Lamb is its lamp.

original.text: καὶ ἡ πόλις οὐ χρείαν ἔχει τοῦ ἡλίου οὐδὲ τῆς σελήνης, ἵνα φαίνωσιν αὐτῇ, ἡ γὰρ δόξα τοῦ θεοῦ ἐφώτισεν αὐτήν, καὶ ὁ λύχνος αὐτῆς τὸ ἀρνίον.

verses.restored: The nations will walk through its light, and kings of earth bring their glory into it.

familiar.text: And the nations of them which are saved shall walk in the light of it: and the kings of the earth do bring their glory and honour into it.

modern.text: By its light the nations will walk, and into it the kings of the earth will bring their glory.

original.text: καὶ περιπατήσουσιν τὰ ἔθνη διὰ τοῦ φωτὸς αὐτῆς· καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς φέρουσιν ⸂τὴν δόξαν αὐτῶν⸃ εἰς αὐτήν·

verses.restored: Its gates will certainly not be shut by day, for night will not be there.

familiar.text: And the gates of it shall not be shut at all by day: for there shall be no night there.

modern.text: Its gates will never be shut at the end of the day, because there will be no night there.

original.text: καὶ οἱ πυλῶνες αὐτῆς οὐ μὴ κλεισθῶσιν ἡμέρας, νὺξ γὰρ οὐκ ἔσται ἐκεῖ,

verses.restored: They will bring glory and honor of nations into it.

familiar.text: And they shall bring the glory and honour of the nations into it.

modern.text: And into the city will be brought the glory and honor of the nations.

original.text: καὶ οἴσουσιν τὴν δόξαν καὶ τὴν τιμὴν τῶν ἐθνῶν εἰς αὐτήν.

verses.restored: Nothing common and no one doing abomination or lie may enter, but only those written in Lamb's scroll of life.

familiar.text: And there shall in no wise enter into it any thing that defileth, neither whatsoever worketh abomination, or maketh a lie: but they which are written in the Lamb’s book of life.

modern.text: But nothing unclean will ever enter it, nor anyone who practices an abomination or a lie, but only those whose names are written in the Lamb’s Book of Life.

original.text: καὶ οὐ μὴ εἰσέλθῃ εἰς αὐτὴν πᾶν κοινὸν καὶ ⸀ποιῶν βδέλυγμα καὶ ψεῦδος, εἰ μὴ οἱ γεγραμμένοι ἐν τῷ βιβλίῳ τῆς ζωῆς τοῦ ἀρνίου.

translation_notes: New Jerusalem unites Israel tribes and Lamb apostles; continuity and fulfillment together, not erasure.
No temple means Divine/Lamb presence fills the city, not anti-temple contempt.
Nations bring glory into city; restoration is international and creation-positive.
safety_note: Revelation 21 is restoration, not escape: tears wiped, death ended, city descends, nations healed into light.
